# Commit Convention

## Format

<type>(<topic>): Problem Name [Difficulty]

## Types

| Type       | When to use                    |
| ---------- | ------------------------------ |
| `add`      | Adding a new solution          |
| `fix`      | Fixing a wrong solution        |
| `refactor` | Improving an existing solution |
| `chore`    | Repo setup, README updates     |

## Examples

add(arrays): Two Sum [Easy]
add(trees): Binary Tree Inorder Traversal [Easy]
fix(dp): Climbing Stairs [Easy]
chore: update README progress table
